name: Third Bridge
description: Third Bridge is an analyst-led expert network founded in 2007 as Cognolink and rebranded in 2015. The firm differentiates from access-model competitors through in-house analyst moderation of its core expert calls, producing structured, comparable, and reusable content. Third Bridge operates across 12 offices on four continents and serves 1,000+ clients, with particular strength in private equity due diligence. Its Library (formerly Forum) contains analyst-led interview transcripts covering 65,000+ companies, and its Maps product provides visual value-chain intelligence on 100,000+ companies. The firm has pursued an open distribution strategy for its content, partnering with Anthropic/Claude, Aiera, Hebbia, and other AI platforms in 2025.

overview: Third Bridge is an analyst-led expert network that differentiates from access-model competitors (like GLG, AlphaSights, and Guidepoint) through in-house analyst moderation of its core Connections product. This produces structured, comparable transcripts that become reusable content in the Library. The firm was originally founded as Cognolink in 2007 by three former Bain & Company consultants and rebranded to Third Bridge in 2015. The name comes from a wooden bridge in Botswana's Okavango Delta — the third bridge travelers cross before entering unexplored territory, symbolizing discovery through local knowledge. Third Bridge serves 1,000+ clients across PE, hedge funds, consulting, and corporate strategy, with 12 offices across four continents and an increasingly open AI distribution strategy for its content.

history.narrative: Third Bridge was founded in 2007 as Cognolink by Emmanuel Tahar (CEO), Joshua Maxey, and Rodolphe De Hemptinne — all former Bain & Company consultants. Bain was reportedly an early client. Lacking a pre-built expert database, Cognolink pioneered custom-sourcing experts directly for live projects. The firm was one of the first to successfully challenge GLG's market dominance, growing in tandem with AlphaSights. In 2015, the company rebranded from Cognolink to Third Bridge, taking the name of one of its business units. The firm has grown to GBP 215 million in revenue (FY2023) with a 46% five-year revenue CAGR, backed by PE investors Astorg and IK Partners, while founders retain majority ownership.

servicesDetailed.name: Connections (Expert Calls)
servicesDetailed.description: Third Bridge's core offering — fundamentally different from access-model competitors. Calls in the Connections product are moderated by in-house Third Bridge analysts who follow structured agendas, probe for depth, and challenge vague answers. Third Bridge also offers direct client-expert interactions for certain use cases. All experts are custom-recruited for each engagement, and self-referred experts are prohibited. Calls include recordings, multilingual transcripts, and AI-generated summaries.

servicesDetailed.name: Library (formerly Forum)
servicesDetailed.description: Third Bridge's most distinctive product: a subscription-based archive of analyst-led expert interviews and company intelligence covering 65,000+ companies. Every analyst-moderated call feeds the Library, creating a compounding content asset. Features AI-powered search, personalized alerts, watchlists, and mobile apps. Content is increasingly distributed through external AI platforms (Claude, Aiera, Hebbia).

servicesDetailed.name: Maps
servicesDetailed.description: Visual value-chain maps for public and private companies — described by Third Bridge as 'a world first for investment research.' Nearly 10,000 Maps covering 100,000+ companies provide visual representations of competitive landscapes, supply chains, and industry structures. Maps complement the Library by providing a structural layer over the qualitative content.

servicesDetailed.name: Surveys
servicesDetailed.description: Custom B2B surveys for market analysis, competitor benchmarking, customer research, and pricing studies. Surveys are designed and managed by Third Bridge's research teams, drawing on the firm's expert sourcing capabilities.

servicesDetailed.name: Advisors
servicesDetailed.description: Long-term advisory engagements connecting clients with senior industry experts for ongoing strategic support beyond one-off calls. Designed for PE portfolio companies and corporate strategy teams needing sustained access to domain expertise.

servicesDetailed.name: Data Feeds
servicesDetailed.description: API and programmatic access to Third Bridge content for integration into clients' own platforms and workflows. Part of the firm's open distribution strategy, enabling institutional clients to embed Third Bridge intelligence into their internal research infrastructure.

aiPlatform.narrative: Third Bridge has pursued an open distribution strategy for its content — contrasting with the 'walled garden' approach of some competitors. Rather than building a single proprietary AI interface, Third Bridge has partnered with multiple AI platforms to make its expert insights available wherever clients work. In October 2025, Third Bridge announced integration with Anthropic's Claude for financial services. Throughout 2025, it also announced partnerships with Aiera (in which it invested), Portrait Analytics, Hebbia, Finster AI, Samaya AI, Rogo, and Model ML. Product-level AI features include AI-powered search across the Library, AI-generated call summaries and transcripts, and personalized alerts and watchlists.

complianceExtended.narrative: Third Bridge's compliance model is structurally differentiated by the analyst-moderated call format in its Connections product. Because these calls are led by in-house Third Bridge interviewers rather than left to direct client-expert interaction, there is an additional layer of compliance oversight built into the core product. Experts are contractually prohibited from disclosing MNPI, must decline participation if they possess MNPI about companies under discussion, and self-referred experts are prohibited entirely. Third Bridge maintains a dedicated global compliance team with regular audits and continuous process updates. Clients can add their own compliance rules and restricted lists.

complianceExtended.regulatoryContext: No known regulatory enforcement actions against Third Bridge were identified in this review. The SEC's 2022 Risk Alert on expert networks was an industry-wide communication, not directed at Third Bridge specifically. The firm's analyst-moderated call format and prohibition on self-referred experts are structural features that reduce certain categories of compliance risk relative to access-only models.

clientFit.narrative: Third Bridge is especially well suited for clients who value curated, analyst-led content and reusable research over raw expert access. The Library creates a compounding knowledge asset that rewards long-term subscription relationships. The firm's PE-centric workflows and structured output format make it particularly strong for deal teams and research-intensive investors.
